description: Check an audit.domains certificate from its verifier URL or serial with two separate checks. Integrity recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the printed fields and needs the full URL; it proves the fields were not altered, not who made them. Issuer authenticity makes one request to the issuer's public verify endpoint to see whether a signed record for the serial reproduces. verified is true only when every check that could run passed; a record that names no signer is not verified. Failures carry a reason code such as integrity_mismatch or not_issued. Runs no valuation.

serial.description: Certificate serial alone. Runs the issuer check only.

url.description: Verifier URL printed on the certificate, https://audit.domains/verify/<serial>?p=<token>. Runs both the integrity and issuer checks.

name: verify_certificate

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

consistency.description: The link's domain, serial, value and date against the issuer's signed record. status is match, mismatch or not_checked.

integrity.description: status is match, mismatch or not_checked. When checked: canonicalString, carriedDigest, recomputedDigest, fields.

issuer.description: status is authentic, not_issued, unsigned_legacy_certificate, unverified_no_key_named, signature_mismatch, issuer_key_unavailable, unreachable or bad_response. Carries the endpoint queried, httpStatus, signingKeyId and the raw response.

retryable.description: True when repeating the call later may change the outcome.

verified.description: True only when every check that could run passed and none failed.

title: Verify an audit.domains certificate
